retrievalProfile.description: A circular vignette of dense tropical foliage set against a solid black square, featuring a smaller rectangular inset of a group portrait.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular aperture reveals a dense thicket of green and brown jungle leaves. Inside this circle, a smaller rectangular photograph of a group of people is centered. The entire composition is surrounded by a solid black field with tight, sans-serif typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Rectangular inset photo centered within the circle
High contrast between black background and vibrant green center
Top-aligned horizontal typography spanning the width of the circle
coreInvariants: Perfect circular mask for the primary image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a circular window taking up 70% of the frame, with a secondary rectangular subject at its dead center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central rectangular group photo acts as the focal point within the larger circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, drop to the large circle, and settle on the central rectangular inset.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black negative space in the corners and outer margins.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the sunlit foliage within the circle.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with varying weights or colors for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, tight geometric feel of late 60s/early 70s soul covers.
Provides the necessary weight and compact structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square. In the center, place a large circular window showing a dense thicket of tropical jungle plants. Inside that circle, place a smaller rectangular photograph of a group of people standing in front of a bus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of centered, uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the top. The first line should be light green, the second line white and larger, and the third line smaller and white.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking tight enough to touch or nearly touch?

mustRedesign: Avoid using modern digital gradients; keep the black background flat.
Ensure the foliage looks like a physical photograph, not an illustration.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is centered horizontally.
Verify the rectangular inset is centered within the circle.
Ensure the foliage does not bleed outside the circular mask.
Confirm the black background is uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black field + Large circular foliage mask + Centered rectangular inset + Top-aligned tight geometric sans-serif typography.
